title: Does Nikai Aircon need water?
desc: Yes definitely it needs water and this accumulates in the internal drain pan. Which evaporates and sends cool air inside.

title: What is the highest temperature of Nikai AC?
desc: The operating temperature range for units is 16-30°C (60-86F). You can increase or decrease the set temperature according to your need.
